## Task 1

```{r}
# 1) Use httr::GET to return topic information 
# using SEPT 01, 2026 as date due to 30 day Free trail restriction

url <- "https://newsapi.org/v2/everything?q=Iran&from=2026-09-01&language=en&pageSize=50&apiKey=b77f47e6761b44f08c28ff6365616d7f"

news_data <- httr::GET(url)
str(news_data, max.level = 1)

# 2) Parse returned information for the actual article information
content(news_data)
news_data_parsed <- fromJSON(rawToChar(news_data$content))

# Store & print actual article information
articles_df <- as_tibble(news_data_parsed$articles)
articles_df

# 3) create a function to autoupdate API key and date
call_news_data <- function( DATE, APIKEY ){

  # generate URL variable based on input vars
  url <- str_c( "https://newsapi.org/v2/everything?q=Iran&from=", DATE, "&language=en&pageSize=50&apiKey=", APIKEY, sep = "")
  
  # calls the data
  data <- httr::GET(url)
  str(data, max.level = 1)
  
  #Parse returned information for the actual article information
  data_parsed <- fromJSON(rawToChar(data$content))
  
  # Store & print actual article information
  articles <- as_tibble(data_parsed$articles)
  articles
}

#test the function x2
call_news_data( "2026-09-15", "b77f47e6761b44f08c28ff6365616d7f")
call_news_data( "2026-09-07", "b77f47e6761b44f08c28ff6365616d7f")

```
